articleTitle: Renewable Energy Sources and Reduction of Operating Costs for Public Lighting in Municipalities
abstract: The reduction of the operating costs for public lighting in the municipalities through the construction of roof photovoltaic power plants (PVPP) on municipal buildings is a reserve that is not used yet. The model “the municipality sells energy to the PVPP during the day and buys it in the evening for the needs of lighting” is advantageous, as the regulations in the Republic of Bulgaria allow energy consumers to become energy producers. The operating costs of roofing PVPPs are low and their maintenance can be part of the maintenance of public lighting systems. The power of the PVPP is chosen such that the revenues from the sale of energy from the PVPP to “cover” the remuneration of the company that maintains the street lighting.

Author Keywords: roof photovoltaic power plants for the needs of public lighting in the municipalities

articleTitle: Method for Construction and Verification of the Stator Winding on a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: This paper aims to present the creation of the stator winding. Which is characterized by sixty stator's slots, the number of the stator's phases is three and two slot for pole and phase. When constructing the stator winding, the geometry of the machine, the possibility for technological and simple construction are taken into account. Another no less important fact that is paid attention to the sinusoidal shape of the magnetomotive force (mmf). The creation of the stator winding is an iterative method, which is presented in detail in this paper. Sequentially go through the following steps- determination of the current densities for each stator's slots, determination of the flux linkage created by permanent magnets and on load mode.

articleTitle: Individual Control of Street Luminaries by Speed of Change of Natural Light in the Evening and by Calendars in the Morning
abstract: Time control of street lighting prevails as a method for group on/off of luminaires powered by a single cassette. It avoids overconsumption of energy from earlier switching on and later switching off of the lighting, which is significant in case of contamination of the photodetector on condition of illuminance control. The report discusses the possibilities of individual management of street lights, as an alternative to group management. The aim is greater flexibility in lighting control of different categories of streets, powered by a common line, as well as eliminating the impact of pollution of the photodetector on inaccurate on / off lighting, respectively, preventing energy overconsumption.

Author Keywords: Control of street lighting and luminaries

articleTitle: Rehabilitation of street lighting systems according to EU Green public procurement criteria
abstract: The document “EU Green Public Procurement Criteria for Road Lighting and traffic signals'2018-19” discusses the basic requirements for the equipment and installation technologies that modern technologies for lighting open spaces in settlements impose when announcing the so-called “Green” public procurement for rehabilitation and modernization of outdoor lighting systems (OLS). The criteria set for the design, implementation and operation of the OLS are interrelated so that the result of the modernization of public lighting has a long-term and sustainable effect.

Author Keywords: rehabilitation and modernization of outdoor lighting systems

articleTitle: Regional and national PACS - Structural and security problems
abstract: Today PACS is a common element of every big and middle size hospital. Problems start when patient has to go other medical institution and to have all medical images needed with him. The idea of inter-hospital picture archiving and remote secured access to them is here. Both structural and security problems of building such a system arise. The proposed paper presents one solution of the presented problem for regional or national PACS.

articleTitle: High Frequency Resonant Current Source of “Boucherot Type” for LED Supply
abstract: Current sources are applicable in various applications. Variety of schemes are well known and used for light emitting diodes (LEDs) supplying devices. In this paper it is presented the mathematical approach for choosing the key elements of high frequency resonant current source of LCL type and realized by a scheme of “Boucherot type”, applicable as LED luminaires, supply and other applications, requiring constant current. A practical simulation model is proposed for investigation of the received load characteristics.

articleTitle: Architectural Lighting Design of the Technical University Educational Campus
abstract: This paper presents three-dimensional (3D) modeling and architectural lighting of space and outdoor objects with different approach. The presented methods allow realistic representation of the design solutions due to the implemented in the project preliminary measured reflection characteristics of the elements’ surfaces.

articleTitle: Stand for Measuring Correlated Color Temperature
abstract: One of the most important characteristics of a light source is the color temperature. The color temperature characterizes the impression of the color sensation of the emitted light. The publication describes the calibration of a stand for measuring correlated color temperature.

articleTitle: Outdoor Lighting and time-variant communication
abstract: The temporal variation in lighting has not been thoroughly studied, even though there are works, either technical or artistic, that exploit this aspect. In this work, under the generalization of the outdoor lighting, two different time scales are considered; fast variations and seasonal differentiations. In the context of the first ones, the temporal variation is used both to provide extra information and point out the message. Specific case studies are used to illustrate cases for various applications of time-variant outdoor lighting.

articleTitle: Considerations for some immunity tests to the disturbances to which LED Luminaires are subjected
abstract: In this paper the authors present the analysis and interpretation of the results of the immunity tests on a LEDs luminaire with an apparent or suspended mounting FIPAD-08 type, subject to a series of typical simulated disturbances, namely: electrostatic discharges, rapid voltage pulse trains, shock waves, drops, short interruptions and voltage variations. The luminaire for which the photometric curves were reconstructed can also be analyzed from a photometric point of view according to the calculation algorithms proposed in the studies previously conducted by the authors.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Thermal Modeling of Industrial LED Luminaire
abstract: In this paper three-dimensional thermal modeling of an industrial LED luminaire with nominal electrical active power 120 W are presented. Results for the temperature distribution at different electrical power of the luminaire and different ambient (operating) temperatures were obtained. The results were verified by thermal imaging.

articleTitle: Comparison of the electrical parameters of industrial lighting systems with LEDs
abstract: The study of the electrical parameters of the lighting systems has been carried out for actually operating industrial sites. These are typical production facilities in the field of food industry; the brewing industry and the processing industry. The lighting systems are made with different luminaires with corresponding power and number. The measurement of the parameters is performed with precise network energy analyzers and by appropriate equipment for them - current transformers, laptop, etc. necessary equipment. The measurements for the different products have been performed for a period between 2 and 6 months. The measuring intervals are set to 5 minutes. All requirements of the current standards for electricity quality (series of standards EN 61000) as well as the normative documents in this field are met. The obtained data are summarized and presented in the respective graphic and tabular form. Relevant conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Investigation of the laser effect of micromechanical properties of stainless steel AISI 304 during the marking process
abstract: The aim of this study was to investigate the microstructure and micromechanical properties of pulsed laser irradiated stainless steel. Laser marking was performed for AISI 304 stainless steel samples using a Nd:YAG fiber laser (1064 nm). AISI 304 steel finds applications in a variety of industries due to its excellent properties: Automotive and aerospace components; Heat exchangers; Kitchen sinks, consumer durables; Chemical containers, including for transport; Food processing equipment, particularly in beer brewing, milk processing, and wine making; Fasteners and flanges manufacturing; Architectural applications such as roofing and cladding, doors and windows. The influence of the process parameters such as pulse repetition frequency and scanning speed at different topology of the surface treatment is considered. The microstructures of the obtained samples were analyzed using confocal optical microscopy (COM). For each square, the roughness of the marking was determined using specialized software and an established methodology. The roughness was measured repeatedly and the mean value for each square was determined together with the root mean square error. Graphs of the dependence of the roughness on the speed and the raster step were obtained. From them, the rate of change of roughness for different intervals of speed and raster step was calculated. Optimal operating intervals of speed and raster beam were determined for the studied steel and this type of laser.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Mechanical Damages of Thin Layer Cadmium Telluride Photovoltaic Panels on Their Electrical Characteristics
abstract: The paper presents a case study on the impact of mechanical defects, such as cracks and impaired sealing, in frameless solar panels based on a thin layer of cadmium telluride (CdTe). The influence of mechanical damages of several defective CdTe photovoltaic panels on their performance is analysed after measuring their I-V and power characteristics. The results show that small mechanical damages, such as fractures, do not significantly affect the efficiency of the panels before moisture penetrates them.

articleTitle: Control of LED driver based on narma L2 controller
abstract: In the current paper a mathematical model of DC/DC Cuk converter is presented. The simulation study is developed in MATLAB/Simulink The mathematical model is described with differential equations and PI regulator. After adjustment of the PI regulator is added a NARMA L2 Controlled for optimization with neuron network. The operation of the converter is demonstrated in various disturbances. The obtained results are useful in view of their use in education and in particular in the synthesis of control.

articleTitle: Effect of Daylight Related Parameters on Lighting Energy Performance According to EN 15193-1:2017
abstract: A significant portion of the electrical energy is consumed for lighting purposes. The daylighting system design has a quite significant role in decreasing the lighting energy usage based on the daylight availability. At this point, determining lighting energy requirements of the building depending on the daylight availability is very important in the design process. In line with this, the present study aims to investigate the updated standard, which is EN 15193-1:2017 by detecting the effect of the daylighting design parameters on the lighting energy requirements. As a result of the study, the importance of the daylighting design parameters and the competency of the standard are revealed by implementing the updated methodology defined in scope of the EN 15193-1:2017.

articleTitle: Advertisement Lighting Applications. Qualitative and Quantitative Criteria
abstract: The paper presents the specific qualitative and quantitative requirements for advertisement lighting. The used methods, regulations and equipment for measuring of the regulated parameters are under consideration.

articleTitle: Investigation of algorithms for virus detection using neural networks and machine learning
abstract: The aim of the project is to study, analyze and research different models of algorithms for neural network training and the application of machine learning. The main goal is to offer a solution that detects malicious files in a large set of data by evaluating each of them. The algorithms are considered Gradient Boosting Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, also, in the proposed appropriate solutions to this problem, neural networks with „deep learning”, as well as techniques from hidden Markov model. They are often a good solution for detecting and classifying malware.

articleTitle: Laser Ablation on Copper Fragments as a Function of Pulse Duration
abstract: Copper is well known for its extraordinary features to increase human immunity in warm weather places. To investigate those properties via nanoparticles, experiments were carried out on copper samples. The process of pulsed laser ablation in a liquid is used to obtain these nanoparticles, so it is extremely important to understand and study the physical mechanism of the laser ablation process. During the laser impact in the treatment area, there is a process of melting, evaporation of the substance, and into the water, these processes have their specifics different from laser ablation in air. As a result of the processing, the copper sample undergoes various structural changes related to the removal of the top layer at a certain specific depth. Therefore, different structural changes are analysed in the present study, with special attention paid to the analysis of the specific depth of laser ablation at different treatment regimens and different patterns. Based on the experimental studies, the amount of substance emitted from the ablation zone per unit time under the different technological regimes is also determined. Because each laser pulse has its characteristic pulse power. Pulse power is a function of pulse duration. This makes it necessary to study the changes in the ablation process with changes in the pulse duration in the range from 2μs to 50μs.

articleTitle: Relationship between lighting levels and vehicle speed in the urban area of ljubljana
abstract: This paper presents a preliminary data analysis of vehicle speed on an urban road under different lighting levels. The speed limit on the road where the speed camera is located (near traffic lights and intersections, with speed bumps) is 50 km/h. The study shows that the vehicle speed was reduced by reducing the lighting level on the road. The lighting level was first reduced from 100 % luminance (road lighting standard is M4 (EN 12301), <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${L_{ave}} = 0.75\,{\text{cd/m}}^{{2}}$</tex>) to 80 % luminance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${L_{ave}} = 0.60\,{\text{cd/}}{\mathrm{m}}^{{2}}$</tex> and then further reduced to 60 % luminance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${L_{ave}} = 0.45\,{\text{cd/m}}^{{2}}$</tex>. After the reduction of luminance, the measurements also show the reduction of vehicle speed. The influence of illuminance level on vehicle speed decreases more after the first reduction from 100 % to 80 % (average speed decrease from 34.32 km/h to 32.85 km/h) than after the second step from 80 % to 60 % level (average speed decrease from 34.32 km/h to 32.85 km/h). There are some differences in the speed-illumination level relationship between different types of vehicles. The illumination level and speed of passenger cars, semi-trucks, trucks, and vans are all positively correlated, and the correlation coefficients R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are above 0.003, which are all statistically significant (p⩽0.005). The speed of a total of 3 059 449 vehicles was measured during this experiment. There were 75 % cars, 11 % vans, 9 % two-wheelers such as motorcycles or bicycles, 3 % trucks, and 2 % semi-trucks.

articleTitle: Aplication of the Finite Element Method to Predict the Colors Obtained by Oxidation Laser Marking of AISI 304 Stainless Steel
abstract: In recent years, conventional marking techniques in mechanical engineering and electronics have increasingly shifted from laser marking. The advantages offered by the new technology are higher positioning accuracy, processing speed, flexibility and a large volume of recorded information per unit area (bar and matrix codes). The study discusses and analyzes the influence of technological parameters influencing the process of laser color marking on AISI 304 stainless steel samples. For this purpose, a stimulation model of the ABAQUS program is used, which allows analyzing the surface temperature and in depth, as well as to connect the isotherms with the technological parameters, power density, processing speed and frequency of the laser pulses.

articleTitle: Modeling of Resonant LLC Converter for LED Lighting Applications
abstract: In this research a mathematical model of LLC resonant converter for supplying a LEDs is studied. The differential equation in the resonant frequency, above and below resonant frequency are described. In this research the ideal case is presented. This model is realized in PowerSim environment. A simulation results of the current and output voltage of the converter are presented. On the base of the model and the obtained results it can be realized different optimization procedure, study of sustainability, tolerance analysis and control synthesis.

articleTitle: Embedded Mobile System for Monitoring of Liquid Foods
abstract: This publication presents an author's solution for a mobile embedded system based on the STM32F769NIH6 microcontroller. The presented implementation allows monitoring of liquid foods by using digital sensors – BME280 and TCS34725. An analysis of the main parameters for monitoring liquid foods has been made. The embedded system has been tested for red wine analysis. Software outputting information to a LCD Daughter Board B-LCD40-DSI1 has been implemented. A functional and price analysis of the proposed system has been made.

articleTitle: Surface Analysis Study of Laser Marking Process of Stainless Steel X5CrNi18-10
abstract: Nowadays, traceability, combined with stable and constant identification of industrial parts, is becoming a crucial element of production processes. Laser marking of metal parts is a technology that shows many advantages compared to labeling, inkjet, or dot marking. The advantages include no consumables, faster cycle time, reliability and repeatability of the process, and stability of the markings. In this article, we aim to study the physics associated with the process of laser colour marking on stainless steel X5CrNi18-10 In a certain range of changes in the technological parameters of 20 W fiber laser. Different color characteristics of the surface are also discussed with regard to the laser parameters. The influence of the raster step, the relative speed of the laser beam, as well as the laser pulses frequency on the color marking process were studied. Test fields consisting of matrices of squares have been created. The laser marking is realized with different parameters for each square. Photographic material of the samples in the processing area is presented. A high-resolution metallographic microscope was used. A universal methodology was used to determine the saturation of the studied colors. Experimental studies were conducted several times in order to verify the repeatability of the results. The influence of the parameters of the laser process on the obtained concrete colour is analyzed and the results are summarized. Intervals of the parameters of processing under laser influence for obtaining a specific colour on this steel are also determined.

articleTitle: Development of Educational Laboratory Equipment for Estimation of the Photometric Flicker Caused by LED Light Sources
abstract: The current paper presents the development of a laboratory equipment for estimation of the photometric flicker of different LED light sources. The equipment is created with educational goal – it is an improvement of existing apparatus in the Lighting Technology Laboratory in the Technical University of Sofia. The idea behind it is to show and give understanding of students on the matter of photometric flicker, temporal lighting artefacts that it creates, the mechanisms that cause flicker and the ways to diminish this problem.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Color Rendering of LED Luminaires for Human Centric Lighting
abstract: The current paper presents an investigation of the color rendering of LED luminaires for Human Centric Lighting. The color rendering index, colorfidelity index, gamut index, color quality scale and gamut area index are measured along with the spectral power distribution and correlated color temperature for each luminaire in two different laboratories. Based on the experimental results, a comment and conclusions are made, giving the basis for further experimental work, allowing better understanding of the color characteristics and parameters of LED lighting.

Author Keywords: color characteristics and parameters of LEDs

articleTitle: A study of cyber attacks: In the healthcare sector
abstract: With the advent of technologies entering into every aspect of humankind, we as human beings need to, both, protect and secure ourselves, from the privileges and imprecations of the technologies. Securing the vast interdisciplinary and interconnected networks from different sectors like, government, military, finance, academics and recently recognized as the most essential and significant sector, who almost touched every human being, the Healthcare sector, has become the most strenuous task. Thus cybersecurity, which constitutes various technologies, processes and practices, designed to protect networks, devices, programs, and data from attack, damages and unauthorized access, attributes more towards surveillance. Healthcare sectors are extensively sensible and realistic to cyber-attacks, wherein disorganization in operations or even divulgence of patient's personal information can have profound consequences. In today's electronic world, as security had become the most vital area for organizations to function uninterruptedly, thus Cyber security had become the most significant and vibrant issue to be explored and researched. Cybersecurity is referred to as computer-based technology, intentionally and accidentally disordering and falsifying the fundamental software, hardware or networked connections. Due to the substantial amalgamation of technology into the healthcare system, Cybersecurity events had become an augment challenge for the healthcare sector. The cybersecurity menace had now approached an existential hazard to the future of the health sector. To upkeep the benefits of health care technology, we must also effectually protect patient information and the essential procedures of our health care entities. Cyber-attacks incidents are growing intimidation to the health care industry in general and hospitals in particular. Cyber-attacks had caused prominent damage to the health sector, breaching into patients personal and professional information, causing millions of dollars loss, in terms of revenues and fines. In this paper, we present the challenges of cyber security in healthcare and cyber-attacks classification based on their targeted security goal. Also, we provide a review of the literature on cybersecurity issues surrounding healthcare and discuss possible solutions to mitigate data breaches and cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Influence of Electromagnetic Waves on the Human Body
abstract: The effect of electromagnetic waves from the light spectrum and nearby frequencies on the human body is a topic that has not been studied in detail. Light waves of different wavelengths affect different human organs. We look at how they affect some major communication organs such as sight, hearing and others. We also show their impact on some internal organs.

articleTitle: Energy and Resource Efficiency of a Biomass Power Plant: Useful Solutions
abstract: The main focus of this article is to consider the challenges regarding the construction and commissioning of a biomass power plant for combined heat and power generation, built on the territory of a livestock enterprise. One part of the generated renewable energy covers the company's own needs, and the rest is redirected to the electricity supply network. The solution of the technical and technological problems related to the specifics of anaerobic decomposition of biomass requires a specific approach.

articleTitle: Impact of Light Distributions on Emotion and Intention to Visit a Fine Dining Restaurant
abstract: For fine-dining restaurants, interior lighting is a critical atmospheric factor influencing guests’ emotional responses, which can, in turn, influence their positive approach behavior, such as intention to visit. This study extended from the previous research, which suggested that focal lighting with dim and warm ambient lighting can positively influence the intention to visit and is mediated by the relational intimacy of the customer. Based on the SOR model, it aims to investigate the impact of seven non-uniform light distributions on subjective emotions and the intention to visit. It also explored the mediating role of relational intimacy. Some 154 Thai respondents participated in the online survey. The result confirmed that the average subjective responses to each light distribution positively influenced the intention to visit. It also demonstrated a more substantial role of relational intimacy in selecting restaurants to dine with a group of friends or a significant other. Additionally, gender appeared to have some effects on this process.

articleTitle: Why Transforming Cities Should Rethink the Scale of Urban Lighting
abstract: Lighting of future cities is a very sensitive issue nowadays and involves, in a transverse way, different disciplines, stakeholders and aspects that cannot be neglected and that are crucial in the urban development and in the life of human beings. The purpose of this paper is to highlight some critical issues that characterize the urban planning of today's cities and to expose cities and citizens evolution. Beside these aspects, the authors aspire to stimulate a multidisciplinary collaboration in the lighting design of urban spaces with greater sensitivity, aimed at supporting urban trends on a human scale considering the built environment, people and nocturnal ecosystem. It is therefore intended to promote the use of light at a human scale in urban spaces, using light as a social tool that intervenes in the perception, emotions and experience of people. The authors want also to sensitize the readers on the responsible use of light outdoors, pointing out that the use of artificial light during the night, inevitably involves the introduction of an artificial element, in fact, and consequently an alteration of the ecosystem. All this will affect the human being and his behavior, safety, well-being and health, discovering new important values of artificial light in the outdoor environment.

articleTitle: An Optical Method for Online Blood Parameters Control
abstract: Optical methods for measuring hematocrits level are not new. The development of medical devices only sets new requirements for the quality of measurement. In the paper are described analyzes and conclusions about the possibility of using optical devices for measuring hematocrits in the new generation of plasmapheresis devices.
